recalled_knowledge.item: Feldman-Cousins 90% CL table entry for n=1, b=0: [0.11, 4.36]; 68.27%: [0.37, 2.75]
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Feldman & Cousins, PRD 57, 3873 (1998), Tables II and IV

recalled_knowledge.item: Asymptotic cdf of t~_mu under mu'=mu with the mu>=0 boundary (two-branch formula), and the 1/2 delta(0) + 1/2 chi2_1 null distribution of t~_0
Baxter et al. (2021) recommend a 90% CL two-sided PLR construction with t~_mu
Baxter et al. recommend reporting a lower limit / two-sided interval only above a 3 sigma significance threshold, otherwise an upper limit
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Baxter et al. (2021), Sec. on reporting

recalled_knowledge.item: Baxter et al. recommend power-constrained limits; PCL with M_min = 0.16 (-1 sigma band)
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Baxter et al. (2021); Cowan, Cranmer, Gross, Vitells arXiv:1105.3166

recalled_knowledge.item: Flip-flopping (switching between a one-sided UL and a two-sided interval on a data-dependent threshold) under-covers; the unified construction avoids it
Gaussian-regime two-sided 90% upper edge mu_hat + 1.645 sigma; -1 sigma sensitivity band at 0.645 sigma
Neutron NR-band background shape ~ exp(-E/50 keV) and atmospheric-nu CEvNS shape ~ exp(-E/28.6 keV) used for the 12-bin toy
recalled_knowledge.reliability: uncertain (affects only the negligible high-energy bins)
